milestones.claim: Define a stable DONE milestone closeout snapshot schema over existing milestone_status rows.
milestones.doneMeans: A closeout snapshot contains every milestone row with status, solvedProblem, acceptance, evidence, risks, nextAction, binding hashes, and source report digest without changing live status semantics.

milestones.claim: Capture the closeout snapshot during DONE readiness before closure metadata can stale the live view.
milestones.doneMeans: DONE advancement produces milestone-closeout.json from a completed risk-free report, and refuses to label incomplete/risk-bearing reports as final closeout success.

milestones.claim: Expose the stable closeout report through a read-only host-neutral command.
milestones.doneMeans: Users and hosts can print text or JSON closeout tables with Milestone, Status, Solved Problem, Acceptance, Evidence, Risks, and Next Action columns, while missing snapshots and mutation-like flags fail clearly.
